metadata.question: Did lake ice extent on Lake Winnipeg, Canada, decrease between May 7, 2021 and May 19, 2021?

data.raw_code: The question is about lake ice extent on Lake Winnipeg between May 7, 2021 and May 19, 2021. This requires: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Use Sentinel-2 or Landsat for high-resolution optical imagery - Focus on Lake Winnipeg geometry - Two time periods: May 7, 2021 and May 19, 2021 (± a few days for cloud-free imagery) 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Need to mask clouds to get clear views of the lake - Identify ice vs water pixels - can use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) or simple reflectance thresholds - Ice typically has high reflectance in visible bands, water has low reflectance 3. **Logic**: - Calculate ice extent (area covered by ice) for both dates - Compare if May 19 ice extent < May 7 ice extent - Need to handle cases where no imagery available or heavy cloud cover For ice detection, I can use: - High reflectance in blue/green bands (ice is bright) - Low NDWI values (ice has different spectral signature than water) - Simple threshold approach: pixels with high reflectance in visible bands and not classified as cloud Let me use Sentinel-2 for better resolution and cloud masking. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakeWinnipeg = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-98.5, 53.5], [-96.0, 53.5], [-96.0, 50.0], [-98.5, 50.0], [-98.5, 53.5]] ]); const date1_start = '2021-05-05'; const date1_end = '2021-05-09'; const date2_start = '2021-05-17'; const date2_end = '2021-05-21'; // 2. Data Acquisition const s2_col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeWinnipeg) .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const s2_col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeWinnipeg) .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); // Check collection sizes const size1 = s2_col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = s2_col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`May 7 period images: ${size1}`); console.log(`May 19 period images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get least cloudy images const img1 = s2_col1.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); const img2 = s2_col2.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); // 3. Ice detection function - high reflectance in blue/green bands indicates ice function detectIce(img) { // Cloud mask using QA60 band const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const qa = img.select('QA60'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); // Apply cloud mask const masked = img.updateMask(mask); // Ice detection: high reflectance in blue band (B2) and green band (B3) const blue = masked.select('B2'); const green = masked.select('B3'); // Simple threshold: pixels with high reflectance in both bands likely ice const ice = blue.gt(1500).and(green.gt(1500)); return ice.rename('ice'); } // Apply ice detection const ice1 = detectIce(img1); const ice2 = detectIce(img2); // 4. Calculate ice extent (pixel counts) const iceStats1 = ice1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeWinnipeg, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const iceStats2 = ice2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeWinnipeg, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const iceCount1 = iceStats1.get('ice').getInfo(); const iceCount2 = iceStats2.get('ice').getInfo(); console.log(`May 7 ice pixels: ${iceCount1}`); console.log(`May 19 ice pixels: ${iceCount2}`); // Check for valid pixels if (iceCount1 === null || iceCount2 === null || iceCount1 === 0 || iceCount2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer const decrease = iceCount2 < iceCount1; const changePercent = ((iceCount2 - iceCount1) / iceCount1 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Ice change: ${changePercent}%`); if (decrease) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
